IK_EN_105.publisher: Tafsir Ibn Kathir (EN, abridged) 105: no Makki/Madani verdict, no separate occasion; Prophet born that year (most popular opinion); Abraha, Al-Qullays church, Abdul-Muttalib 'the House has its Lord' (Ibn Ishaq); elephant Mahmud knelt; birds from the sea; word meanings ababil (Ibn 'Abbas, Dahhak, Hasan, Qatada, Mujahid, Ibn Zayd), sijjil (Ibn Hisham, Yunus, Abu 'Ubaydah), 'asf ma'kul (Sa'id bin Jubayr, Hasan, Ibn 'Abbas, Ibn Zayd); Prophet recalled this favour to Quraysh (Ibn Ishaq)

TB_105.publisher: Tafsir al-Tabari (AR) 105: ashab al-fil = Abraha's army; kayd fi tadlil; ababil (no singular; Ibn 'Abbas, Ibn Mas'ud, Hasan, Qatada, Mujahid, Ibn Zayd); sijjil = stone+clay (Ibn 'Abbas via 'Ikrima; Tabari rejects 'name of the lowest heaven'); 'asf ma'kul (Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, Qatada, Ibn Zayd); long Abraha narration after Ibn Ishaq; some chains flagged weak by editors; no Makki/Madani verdict

QT_105.publisher: Tafsir al-Qurtubi (AR) 105: five verses; Makki by consensus (ijma'); detailed Abraha story (Qulleys, Nasa'a man, Dhu Nafr, Nufayl, Abu Righal, 200 camels, Abdul-Muttalib); year-of-elephant dating variants (Muqatil 40 y, Kalbi/'Ubayd bin 'Umayr 23 y); Prophet born in Year of the Elephant (variant 'Day of the Elephant', Mawardi); does not explain ababil/sijjil/asf

MQ_105.publisher: Ma'ariful Qur'an (EN) 105: no Makki/Madani verdict; Abraha + cathedral; Prophet born that year (popular historical view, citing IK); 'alam tara' wording explained (widely witnessed event); elephant Mahmud refused to enter; irhas not mu'jiza; Waqidi/Aisha/Asma reports (not used)

QCOM_105.publisher: Quran.com surah info 105: Makkan by consensus; 19th revealed, after Al-Kafirun, before Al-Falaq (minority: before Quraysh); 5 verses; other name 'Surat A-lam Tara'; summary: reminds Quraysh of the event, affirms Makka's sanctity

facts.claim: Arabic 105:1-5 = Tanzil Uthmani bytes (ayat[]); CC BY 3.0, verbatim, credit Tanzil Project + link; sha256 on PC
Hindi = saral bhaavarth from 3 accepted translations (Suhel Farooq Khan, Muhammad Farooq Khan, Mahmud al-Hasan PD); nothing copied; 'ai rasool' and 'kharanj' (T1) not taken
Latin transliteration for the Devanagari ucharan (Tanzil ara-quran-la + quran411 ara-quran-la1), both read; ucharan.md tags U1-U10
Surah 105 = Al-Fil (الفيل), named from 'ashab al-fil' in the first verse; 105th surah; 5 ayat; juz 30
Makki: Qurtubi 'by consensus'; quran.com Makkan by consensus; Alim (Maududi) unanimously Makki; no madani view found
Order of revelation: quran.com '19th, after Al-Kafirun, before Al-Falaq' - single opened source
Other name 'Surat A-lam Tara' (from first words) - quran.com only
Main message: Allah reminded Quraysh of the event; the army that came to destroy the Ka'ba was brought to nothing; Allah protects His House
Surah flow: question -> scheme brought to nothing -> flocks of birds -> stones of baked clay -> like eaten husks
No separate sabab-e-nuzul: the surah itself refers to the Year of the Elephant event; Ibn Ishaq (in IK): the Prophet reminded Quraysh of this favour of Allah

The event is in the 'Year of the Elephant', the year the Prophet was born according to the popular view (IK EN, Qurtubi, Ma'ariful); gap between event and birth disputed (Muqatil 40 y, Kalbi/'Ubayd 23 y in Qurtubi) - no CE year in the video

Abraha, Abyssinian governor of Yemen, built the church Al-Qullays in San'a to turn Arab pilgrimage from the Ka'ba, vowed to destroy the Ka'ba and marched with an elephant; cause of the church incident differs (not used)
Abdul-Muttalib, leader of Quraysh, to Abraha (via Ibn Ishaq): the House has its Lord who will protect it; ~200 camels; some chains weak per editors - only this one line, 'riwayat me aata hai'
The elephant (named Mahmud) knelt/refused to advance towards Makka
No sahih virtue (fazilat) report for reciting 105 opened; no fazilat claim in the video
105:1 j1-j2 - 'alam tara' = 'did you not see/know' (event widely known); ashab al-fil = Abraha's elephant army
105:2 j1 - kayd = scheme/plot (to destroy the Ka'ba)
105:2 j2 - tadleel = brought to nothing / led astray from its aim (Tabari)
105:3 - Allah sent upon them flocks of birds; ababil = flock after flock (Ibn 'Abbas, Hasan, Qatada, Mujahid; no singular per Tabari)
105:4 - they pelted them with stones of sijjeel = baked clay (Ibn 'Abbas via 'Ikrima: stone and clay; Ibn Hisham: hard)
105:5 - 'asf ma'kul = eaten husk/straw (Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, Qatada, Sa'id bin Jubayr, Hasan); they were left like it - utterly ruined
Whole surah: Allah's power over any scheme; protection of His House; reminder to Quraysh (IK/Qurtubi/Ma'ariful)
